overview: Right-click a bundle and it opens as a grid, so you can take the one item you want out of the middle instead of unpacking everything sitting on top of it.

1.1.5: Release notes rewritten to read plainly; nothing in play changes.
1.1.4: A lighter icon, and a build for the current game.
1.1.2: An extraction no longer carries on after the bundle is closed.
Clicks and text colours were put right for the current game.
1.0.0: Any bundle in your inventory opens as a chest-like grid.
Click an item to pull it out, or empty the whole bundle at once.
Client side only, so it works on any server.
